target.description: The target tensor representing the true binary labels. Its shape should match the shape of the `output` tensor.

output.description: The output tensor representing the predicted probabilities or logits. Its shape should match the shape of the `target` tensor.

from_logits.description: (optional) Whether `output` is a tensor of logits or probabilities. Set it to `True` if `output` represents logits; otherwise, set it to `False` if `output` represents probabilities. Defaults to `False`.

output.description: The computed binary cross-entropy loss between `target` and `output`.
